[LLSU.2.1] These are available to every program under every setting;
none is a capability ([LDIA.4.2]). A dialect definition naming one fails
to load with `DS_VALIDATE_DIALECT_UNKNOWN_CAPABILITY` ([NDLC.2.2]).

| Name | Explanation | Refactor hint |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_decl` | `schema <Name> [<qualifier>]:` declaration over an indented slot block | not generally avoidable |
| `schema_lifecycle` | `logical` / `ttl` lifecycle on a schema declaration | not generally avoidable |
| `rule_decl` | `rule <name> <lhs> -> <rhs>` declaration | not generally avoidable |
| `pattern_match` | LHS pattern matching on schema constructor | not generally avoidable |
| `pattern_binding` | `<Schema> <binding>` explicit pattern binding | not generally avoidable |
| `where_clause` | `where <expression>` on patterns | not generally avoidable |
| `pattern_not` | `not <…>` logical connector — a logic shape, sibling to `or` and `and`, and unrelated to absence. Distinct from `no <pattern>`, which is a pattern shape ([LGRA.2.11.5]) | not generally avoidable |
| `pattern_or` | `(<pattern> or <pattern>)` disjunction | not generally avoidable |
| `expression` | the expression grammar (arithmetic, comparison, bool ops) per EXPRESSIONS | not generally avoidable |
| `emit_intratier` | `emit <Schema>` — assert a fact into the current tier's working memory | not generally avoidable |
| `log_action` | `log <level> "<msg>"` action | rewrite using the integrator-provided logging adapter if available |
